data.title: Biographical Notes – Mariève B. Tremblay
data.author: Department of Finance Canada
data.summary: Ms. Mariève B. Tremblay is a senior executive, lawyer and corporate director with more than 25 years of leadership experience across the transportation and logistics, energy, mining, and industrial sectors. She has held executive and leadership positions with major Canadian and international organizations, including CN, Nature Energy, The CSL Group, Alcan/Rio Tinto, and Bombardier. Her mandates have encompassed corporate strategy, business development and commercial leadership, procurement and supply chain, technology and cybersecurity, environmental, social and governance (ESG) matters, corporate partnerships, and business transformation.

data.title: Biographical Notes – Francis A. Mensah
data.author: Department of Finance Canada
data.summary: Mr. Francis A. Mensah has served as Vice-President, Finance and Administration, and Chief Financial Officer at the Royal Canadian Mint since 2022. Prior to this role, Mr. Mensah served as Deputy Chief Risk Officer at the Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation (CMHC) and Director of Corporate Accounting at Export Development Canada (EDC).

data.title: Pirutsiagutiit National Framework
data.author: Indigenous Services Canada
data.summary: Pirutsiagutiit, meaning "resources for growing well" in Inuktut, is a new Inuit-led program that will help Inuit children access the health, social and educational products, services and supports they need. The program will launch on April 1, 2027, replacing the interim Inuit Child First Initiative.

data.title: The Government of Canada, together with the Province of Ontario, invests in strengthening trade capacity and supply chain resilience through the Port of Sault Ste. Marie
data.author: Transport Canada
data.summary: Today, the Honourable Steven MacKinnon, Minister of Transport and Leader of the Government in the House of Commons, announced an investment of up to $125 million through the Trade Diversification Corridors Fund to support the development of the Port of Sault Ste. Marie, led by the Hamilton-Oshawa Port Authority. This investment will fund a series of improvements to unlock the Port's potential as a key transportation and trade hub, increasing its cargo-handling capacity to more than 3.5 million metric tonnes annually by 2031, a three-fold increase over current volumes. The project is expected to create 2,150 direct and 2,600 indirect jobs while strengthening supply chains and supporting economic growth across Northern Ontario and beyond.

https://www.canada.ca/en/transport-canad.label: The Government of Canada, together with the Province of Ontario, invests in strengthening trade capacity and supply chain resilience through the Port of Sault Ste. Marie

data.title: Statement by Minister Rechie Valdez on Transgender Day of Remembrance
data.author: Women and Gender Equality Canada
data.summary:
Today, the Honourable Rechie Valdez, Minister of Women and Gender Equality and Secretary of State (Small Business and Tourism), made the following statement on Transgender Day of Remembrance:
"Today, on Transgender Day of Remembrance, we honour the lives of transgender and gender-diverse people who have been lost to violence and hatred. We remember them, mourn alongside their loved ones, and reaffirm our collective responsibility to build a country where everyone can live safely and with dignity.

https://www.canada.ca/en/women-gender-eq.label: Statement by Minister Rechie Valdez on Transgender Day of Remembrance
